en.headline: Princess Margaret Hospital evacuates Block G after gas report
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said floors 12 to 14 of the Kwai Chung hospital’s pathology block were cleared around 9am; emergency services were not affected.
body: Princess Margaret Hospital received a report of an unknown gas at about 9am on Wednesday, the Hospital Authority said, affecting the 12th to 14th floors of Block G in Kwai Chung.

The authority said those floors are pathology workplaces and do not house patient services or treatment facilities. Staff and visitors on the three floors were told to leave. Star Headline reported that 105 people, 50 men and 55 women, were directed to open ground near Block K. Hong Kong 01 put the figure at 105 personnel.

Fire officers and police attended, and Towngas staff were also seen at the scene. The Hospital Authority said the hospital would investigate the source of the report with the Fire Services Department, and that emergency services at Princess Margaret Hospital were not affected.

Hong Kong 01 later reported that crews found no leak after about an hour and that the Fire Services Department classified the call as a good-faith false alarm. The Hospital Authority had not issued a separate statement confirming that classification by late morning.

zh.headline: 瑪嘉烈醫院G座接不明氣體報告 病理樓三層疏散
zh.dek: 醫管局指今早約9時葵涌瑪嘉烈醫院G座12至14樓接報，屬病理部工作樓層，不涉病人服務，急症服務未受影響。
body: 醫院管理局表示，瑪嘉烈醫院今日早上約9時接獲不明氣體報告，受影響範圍為G座12至14樓。
醫管局指，有關樓層是病理部工作樓層，並沒有病人服務或治療設施，院方隨即安排該三層員工及訪客離開。《星島頭條》報道共疏散105人，包括50男55女，人員集中在K座對開空地；《香港01》亦報道疏散105人。
消防及警方到場處理，煤氣公司人員亦在場了解。醫管局稱，院方會聯同消防處調查氣體來源，其間瑪嘉烈醫院緊急服務沒有受影響。
《香港01》其後報道，人員約一小時後確定沒有漏氣，消防處列為善意虛報。截至上午較後時間，醫管局未另發聲明確認該分類。
